title: Google says Gemini Deep Research can now directly draw on information stored in users' Gmail, Drive, and Chat to create reports (Abner Li/9to5Google)
summary: Abner Li /9to5Google:Google says Gemini Deep Research can now directly draw on information stored in users' Gmail, Drive, and Chat to create reports—  After adding PDF support in May, Gemini Deep Research can now directly tap information stored in your Gmail and Google Chat conversations, as well as Google Drive files.
